items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Always have old Matt Martin, he had no good you know, he liked Rubichaud.

ctx.x: city bands would come out here? Let's see. Robichaud used to come out here. John Robichaud? The violin player? Yeah, the violin player. I mean the violin player, left-handed. Yeah, really good. Well they only had bass and trumpet and that's like we talked, that's all he used to have. Short band? Yeah, he had no drum at that time. And I'd be, I think I'd find out, I can't call his name, I'd find out me to come out here. But Rubichaud used to be more so popular than the others. Always have old Matt Martin, he had…
Well I think we better get on up the road and see your friend, we should appreciate this. Yeah, you got it for me, just me.
